description: Header file defining classes and types for PWM waveform management in an EFI firmware module, including classes for single-channel waves (`SingleWave`) and multi-channel waves (`MultiWave`), with associated type definitions and constants.

classes.name: SingleWave
classes.description: Represents a sequence of digital signal states (HIGH/LOW) for one channel in a PWM waveform.

classes.name: MultiWave
classes.description: Represents multi-channel PWM signals sharing a common time axis, allowing retrieval and setting of switch times and channel states.

methods.name: SingleWave(pin_state_t *pinStates)
methods.description: Constructor initializing with given pin states.

methods.name: void init(pin_state_t *pinStates)
methods.description: Initializes the SingleWave object with pin states.

methods.name: pin_state_t getState(int switchIndex)
methods.description: Returns the signal state (HIGH/LOW) at a specific index.

methods.name: void setState(int switchIndex, pin_state_t state)
methods.description: Sets the signal state at a specific index.

methods.name: MultiWave(float *switchTimes, SingleWave *waves)
methods.description: Constructor initializing multi-wave with switch times and channels.

methods.name: void init(float *switchTimes, SingleWave *waves)
methods.description: Initializes MultiWave with switch times and channels.

methods.name: void reset(void)
methods.description: Resets the MultiWave object to initial state.

methods.name: float getSwitchTime(int phaseIndex) const
methods.description: Returns the switch time for a given phase.

methods.name: void setSwitchTime(int phaseIndex, float value)
methods.description: Sets the switch time for a specific phase.

methods.name: pin_state_t getChannelState(int channelIndex, int phaseIndex) const
methods.description: Returns the state of a specific channel at a given phase.

methods.name: int findAngleMatch(float angle, int size) const
methods.description: Finds index where the angle matches.

methods.name: int findInsertionAngle(float angle, int size) const
methods.description: Finds position to insert an angle.
